title: Dragon Dice spell data
description: Hand-authored, like presets.json -- no importer writes this file. The eighteen spells castable by Treefolk and Firewalkers, from the full rules pp. 46-51. A spell carries at most one of `effect` (declarative: modifiers plus a duration) and `handler` (a named function in src/engine/spells.ts). It may carry neither, which means transcribed but not yet implemented: `resolvesSpell` answers false for it and `castableSpells` never offers it.

id.description: Stable key. Used by the engine, never shown to a player.

element.description: A single-element spell may only be cast with magic of that element; an Elemental spell with magic of any one element.

species.description: `any`, or a species id from units.json. A species spell may only be cast with magic generated by that species.

target.description: What the caster names when announcing. The rules' five target kinds (army, unit(s), terrain, DUA, BUA), split by whose it may be. `own_army` is the house rule that a beneficial army spell reaches only your own armies (RULES-V0.md section 15); `own_dua` is units in your DUA (Resurrect Dead), `dua` the area itself (Accelerated Growth).

cumulative.description: The rulebook prints the combinable number in red, which text extraction drops -- this is that fact, read off the rendered page. Combined castings multiply the highlighted number; a non-cumulative spell cast twice on one target does nothing extra.

reserves.description: The `R` column: castable by an army in the Reserve Area.

cantrip.description: The `C` column: castable with magic results the Cantrip SAI generated outside a magic action.

text.description: The rules text, verbatim. Both clients render this; there is no second copy in TypeScript.

effect.description: A declarative spell: modifiers on a target, for a duration. Anything else needs a `handler`.

scope.description: Who the effect reaches. The last three are terrain-scoped: every army standing there, an army attacking into there, and an army maneuvering there.

resultType.description: A result type, or `*` for every one of them -- Ash Storm subtracts from all results and five rows here would be five places to get it wrong.

duration.description: Every spell in scope that lasts at all lasts until the beginning of the caster's next turn. An instantaneous spell has a handler, not an effect.

handler.description: Names a function in src/engine/spells.ts. Means the spell does something at resolution time that is not an Effect.
